issue.description: The locked V1.5 evaluator re-aggregates Primary hypotheses at a common 60-trading-day horizon whenever 60 is in outcomePolicy, even when individual memos pre-register different baseTradingDays.
issue.codeBehavior: primaryOpportunityLevel is called with 60 when manifest.outcomePolicy.holdingTradingDays includes 60, then opportunityFirstBase reads each hypothesis at that common horizon.
issue.consequence: The 20d Xiangshui dye thesis is correctly stored in thesisBaseOutcome but is incorrectly treated at 60d by legacy opportunityFirstBase, turning a +7.24pp base-horizon success into a -9.89pp common-horizon failure.

canonicalMetricsForV15.source: Each primary result.thesisBaseOutcome keyed to expectedRealization.baseTradingDays.

remediation.action: Keep locked outcome immutable. Add a separate heterogeneous-base audit/reporting tool and use primaryThesisBase / per-memo thesisBaseOutcome as canonical V1.5 base metrics.
remediation.futureCoreChange: A future evaluator revision may replace the common-60d opportunityFirstBase aggregation with grouping on each memo's frozen base horizon, but that is a reporting compatibility change, not a selection-rule change.
